comments.author: B***o
comments.content: Very disappointed how early bird discount worked sa platform na to. Got the discount na almost matched sa Poco official, then almost after 48 hours tsaka sila nag offer ng vouchers. I understand I could have just returned the item para marefund then process yung order ulit with a lower price, pero di man lang makapag accommodate ang customer service ng anything para less hassle sa overall process. Delivery rider was very nice. Ended up accepting and just move on. Yea not true lowest price guarantee and got mislead, much better off pala wait nyo talaga magsale + vouchers. Nadala siguro sa hype. Very bad customer service in my opinion.
